scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter mobile build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter mobile lint && pnpm --filter api lint && pnpm --filter shared lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter shared typecheck
scripts.test: SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=test-key pnpm --filter mobile test && SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=test-key pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter shared test
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter mobile clean && pnpm --filter api clean && pnpm --filter shared clean
